definitions.explanation: Figuratively refers to trouble, conflict, or disruption in relationships or situations. Most commonly used in the expression 波風を立てる (to stir up trouble).
The literal meaning of waves and wind on the sea.

examples.japanese: {波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てたくない→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to stir up trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live peacefully without stirring up trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧{波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you'd stop saying unnecessary things and causing trouble.
The waves and wind on the sea are strong.

examples.japanese: {波風|なみかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収|おさ}まる→収まる：11858_osamaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We waited for the waves and wind to die down before setting sail.

examples.japanese: {波風|なみかぜ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めている→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: Looking at a calm sea without waves or wind puts my mind at ease.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (trouble, discord) is far more common than the literal sense. The key expression is {波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to stir up trouble / to rock the boat). The negative form {波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てない→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ reflects the Japanese cultural value of maintaining harmony.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to stir up trouble)
- {波風|なみかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (trouble arises)
- {波風|なみかぜ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てない→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to not rock the boat)
